generic.Defined scope/population: The named insured plus any parent or subsidiary entity shown on the submission that carries the exposure
generic.In-scope period: The two most recent fiscal years of financial statements and a D&B report pulled within 90 days
generic.Required fields populated and valid: D-U-N-S, PAYDEX, Failure Score, current ratio, debt-to-equity and financial grade all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Ratios recomputed from the attached statements agree to the figures keyed on the financial tab
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: D&B report and both statements attached to the account with pull date and report version shown
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every lien, judgment, bankruptcy or going-concern flag logged with the underwriting response recorded
generic.Test population: All accounts carrying a completed financial strength assessment in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the grade is missing, unjustified, or unsupported by the attached financial evidence
generic.Exception handling path: Ungraded or evidence-short accounts return to the Underwriter before any terms are released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Grade A-D present with a one-line justification and both credit and statement evidence attached
generic.Evidence location: Financial tab of the account record in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Pull the D&B business report in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Search LexisNexis Risk by legal entity name, address and tax ID to locate the exact insured entity
Pull the D&B report and capture the D-U-N-S number, PAYDEX score and Failure Score
Save the report to the account file with its pull date recorded
Done when the D&B report is attached and the three identifiers are keyed on the financial tab
verify: Confirm the entity named on the report matches the named insured on the submission
Confirm PAYDEX and Failure Score fields are populated on the financial tab
Pass when the attached D&B report matches the keyed scores

steps.title: Attach audited financial statements in the underwriting workstation
sop: Request the two most recent audited or reviewed statements from the broker if not in the submission
Attach both statements to the account financial tab and record the fiscal year end of each
Where only unaudited figures are available, record why they were accepted
Done when two years of statements or a documented acceptance of unaudited figures are on file
verify: Confirm the two attached statements are consecutive fiscal years
Confirm the auditor or preparer name is legible on each statement
Pass when two years of statements are attached or the unaudited note is present

steps.title: Compute liquidity and leverage ratios on the workstation financial tab
sop: Read current assets, current liabilities, total debt and equity from each attached statement
Compute current ratio and debt-to-equity for both years and key them to the financial tab
Compute the EBITDA trend across the two years and record the direction and percentage change
Done when both years of ratios and the EBITDA trend are recorded on the financial tab
verify: Recompute one ratio from the statement and compare it to the keyed value
Confirm both fiscal years carry a value for every ratio field
Pass when recomputed ratios agree with the keyed figures

steps.title: Screen for liens, judgments and going-concern flags in LexisNexis Risk
sop: Run the bankruptcy, lien and judgment search on the insured entity in LexisNexis Risk
Read the auditor opinion for any going-concern qualification or material uncertainty
Log each adverse finding on the financial tab with the underwriting response taken
Done when every adverse finding carries a recorded underwriting response
verify: Confirm the search covers the insured entity and any parent named on the submission
Confirm no adverse finding is left without a response note
Pass when all flagged items show a disposition

steps.title: Record the financial strength grade on the account
sop: Weigh the credit scores, ratio trend and adverse findings against the financial grading guideline
Select the grade A to D and enter it in the workstation financial assessment field
Write a one-line justification naming the decisive metric or finding
Done when the grade and its justification are saved on the account
verify: Confirm the grade field and the justification field are both populated
Confirm the justification names a metric visible in the attached evidence
Pass when grade and justification are present and evidence-backed

steps.title: Review and sign off the financial assessment in the workstation
sop: Open the financial tab and read the grade, justification and adverse-finding dispositions
Challenge any grade that conflicts with the ratio trend or an open going-concern flag
Record agreement or send the assessment back with the specific point to rework
Done when the assessment carries a dated reviewer sign-off
verify: Confirm the sign-off names the reviewer and carries a date
Confirm no returned item remains unresolved on the account
Pass when the assessment is signed off with no open rework item

generic.Defined scope/population: Every insured location and operation shown on the statement of values for the hazard and controls review

steps.title: Check survey currency and order surveys in the underwriting workstation
sop: List every location and read the date of its most recent survey or inspection report
Compare each date against the guideline age limit of 36 months
Raise a survey order for any location that is stale or never surveyed
Done when every location has a current survey or an open survey order
verify: Confirm the survey date is recorded for every location on the schedule
Confirm each stale location carries an open order reference
Pass when no location is both stale and unordered

steps.title: Record COPE attributes per location in the underwriting workstation
sop: Read construction class, occupancy hazard grade and protection class from the survey report
Record the exposure distance to adjoining hazards for each location
Key all four COPE attributes against the matching location row
Done when every location row carries a complete set of COPE attributes
verify: Confirm the assessed location count matches the statement of values count
Confirm no COPE field is left blank or defaulted
Pass when all locations carry complete COPE data

steps.title: Verify sprinkler and alarm protection status on each location record
sop: Confirm sprinkler coverage, design density and hydraulic adequacy from the survey report
Confirm alarm type and central station certification with the certificate reference
Record protection status and any impairment history against each protected location
Done when every protected location shows verified protection with a certificate reference
verify: Confirm certificates are current for each central station claim
Confirm unprotected locations are flagged rather than left blank
Pass when protection status is evidenced for every location

steps.title: Disposition open loss control recommendations in the workstation
sop: List every open recommendation from the survey with its priority rating
Mark each accepted, rejected or to be carried as a policy subjectivity
Record the reason for any rejection and the compensating control relied on
Done when no recommendation is left without a disposition and reason
verify: Confirm every high-priority recommendation carries a disposition
Confirm rejections name a compensating control
Pass when the open recommendation list has zero undispositioned items

steps.title: Score the risk control programme and set the hazard grade
sop: Score housekeeping, hot work permitting, driver qualification and management of change
Combine the scores with the COPE profile to select the hazard grade
Enter the score sheet and hazard grade on the account risk assessment tab
Done when the hazard grade and its component scores are saved on the account
verify: Confirm each programme element carries a score rather than a default
Confirm the hazard grade is consistent with the scored elements
Pass when grade and component scores are both present

steps.title: Confirm the assessment carries to the policy administration system
sop: Review the hazard grade, COPE data and recommendation dispositions on the account
Confirm any subjectivity created is loaded to the policy administration system
Record reviewer agreement or return the assessment with the point to rework
Done when the reviewed assessment and its subjectivities are on the policy record
verify: Confirm each subjectivity in the workstation appears on the policy record
Confirm the review sign-off is dated and attributed
Pass when subjectivities match across both systems and sign-off is present

steps.title: Assemble the loss and exposure data set in Microsoft Excel

Load both into the loss analysis workbook and record each valuation date

Confirm incurred totals tie to the loss runs attached to the account

steps.title: Develop incurred losses to ultimate in the Excel workbook
sop: Select the loss development factor set for the line and record its source and version
Apply the factors to each policy year to produce developed ultimate losses
Note the maturity in months used for each year's factor selection
Done when every policy year shows a developed ultimate loss and its factor
verify: Confirm the factor applied matches the maturity of each year
Confirm the factor source and version are recorded in the workbook
Pass when all years are developed with documented factors

steps.title: Trend losses and exposures to the prospective period
sop: Select loss and exposure trend rates and record the source used for each
Trend developed losses and exposures forward to the prospective policy period
State the trend period in years applied to each policy year
Done when trended losses and exposures are shown alongside the untrended figures
verify: Confirm the trend rates and period are stated in the workbook
Confirm untrended and trended columns are both retained
Pass when trend basis is documented for every year

steps.title: Compute per-year and all-years loss ratios in the workbook
sop: On-level the earned premium for each year and record the rate change history used
Divide developed trended ultimate losses by on-level earned premium for each year
Compute the all-years weighted loss ratio across the experience period
Done when per-year and all-years loss ratios are computed and displayed
verify: Confirm the on-level factors reference a stated rate change history
Recompute one year's ratio and compare it to the workbook value
Pass when the recomputed ratio matches the workbook

steps.title: Compute claim frequency per exposure unit by year
sop: Select the exposure unit appropriate to the line such as payroll, vehicles or revenue
Divide claim counts by exposure units for each policy year using a consistent basis
Record the frequency series and the unit basis in the workbook
Done when a frequency figure exists for each policy year on a stated basis
verify: Confirm the same exposure unit basis is used across all years
Confirm claim counts match the loss run counts
Pass when frequency is computed consistently for every year

steps.title: Flag large-loss distortion and publish the exhibit to Power BI
sop: Identify any year where a single claim drives more than the large-loss threshold share
Recompute that year's ratio excluding losses above the large-loss threshold
Publish the exhibit to the Power BI account view and attach the workbook to the account
Done when the exhibit shows both gross and ex-large-loss ratios and is attached
verify: Confirm each flagged year shows both ratio versions
Confirm the published exhibit figures match the attached workbook
Pass when published and attached figures agree

generic.Defined scope/population: Every location, operation and exposure unit declared on the submission statement of values

steps.title: Load the statement of values into Microsoft Excel

steps.title: Geocode all locations in the underwriting workstation

verify: Confirm no location carries a postcode-centroid or failed match

steps.title: Reconcile schedule TIV to the declared premium base
sop: Total TIV across all locations in the loaded schedule
Compare the total to the premium base declared on the submission
Investigate and explain any variance above five percent with the broker

verify: Confirm the totals comparison is shown in the workbook
Confirm each variance above threshold has an explanation
Pass when reconciliation is shown and variances explained

steps.title: Compare exposure bases to the expiring term in the workstation
sop: Pull the expiring payroll, sales, vehicle count and headcount from the prior term record
Compute the change for each exposure base against the new declaration
Query the broker on any base moving more than twenty percent and record the answer
Done when every material exposure change carries a recorded explanation
verify: Confirm the prior-term comparison is present for each exposure base
Confirm every change over twenty percent has a broker answer logged
Pass when all material changes are explained

steps.title: Flag cat-exposed locations for aggregation review
sop: Identify locations in flood zones, seismic zones and named-storm tiers from the geocode results
Tag each such location on the schedule with the peril and zone identifier
Route the tagged list to exposure management for aggregate position review
Done when every cat-exposed location is tagged and routed
verify: Confirm the tagged set matches the zones returned by geocoding
Confirm the routing to exposure management is recorded
Pass when tagged locations are complete and routed

steps.title: Verify and lock the exposure schedule on the account
sop: Review geocode quality, TIV reconciliation and cat tagging on the compiled schedule
Confirm the aggregate position remains inside zone capacity for the tagged locations
Mark the schedule verified and attach it to the account record
Done when the verified schedule is attached and marked locked
verify: Confirm the verification stamp names the reviewer and the date
Confirm the locked schedule matches the reconciled totals
Pass when the schedule is verified, locked and attached

generic.Defined scope/population: The account under consideration, covering its operations, hazards, loss experience and financial condition
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term informed by the five-year loss and two-year financial review
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Narrative text, risk quality score, appetite class and residual concerns all populated

steps.title: Draft the operations and hazard narrative in the workstation
sop: Describe what the insured does, where it operates and the processes that create exposure
Summarise the hazard profile drawn from the COPE data and survey findings
Keep the description factual and free of unsupported characterisation
Done when the operations and hazard sections are drafted on the analysis tab
verify: Confirm the hazard description matches the recorded hazard grade
Confirm each operation named appears on the exposure schedule
Pass when narrative and underlying data agree

steps.title: Write the loss experience and financial condition read
sop: Summarise the loss ratio and frequency findings and name the drivers behind them
Summarise the financial strength grade and the metric that drove it
Reference the exhibit and financial tab rather than restating raw figures
Done when both sections are drafted and reference their source exhibits
verify: Confirm the loss read matches the loss ratio exhibit conclusion
Confirm the financial read matches the recorded financial grade
Pass when both reads agree with their source records

steps.title: State the risk quality score and its drivers on the account
sop: Compute or confirm the risk quality score from the scoring model on the account
Name the attributes that pushed the score up and those that pushed it down
Enter the score in the score field and repeat it in the narrative text
Done when the score and its named drivers are recorded
verify: Confirm the score in the narrative equals the score field value
Confirm at least one upward and one downward driver are named
Pass when score and drivers are consistent and present

steps.title: Name the appetite class and cite the governing guideline
sop: Match the account class and hazard profile to the documented appetite classes
Record the appetite class the account falls in
Cite the specific guideline paragraph relied on by number
Done when the appetite class and guideline citation are recorded
verify: Confirm the cited paragraph exists in the current guideline version
Confirm the class named matches the account class code
Pass when citation and class both check out

steps.title: List residual concerns carried into terms
sop: List each concern the analysis did not resolve such as protection gaps or loss trend
Link each concern to the subjectivity, exclusion or deductible level that addresses it
Flag any concern with no mitigating term for discussion at review
Done when every residual concern is listed against its mitigating term
verify: Confirm each listed concern names a term or is flagged as unmitigated
Confirm the mitigating terms appear on the draft quote
Pass when concerns and terms are linked with no silent gaps

steps.title: Lock the narrative in the policy administration system record
sop: Read the completed narrative against the exhibits and the risk quality score
Challenge any conclusion the evidence does not support and return it if needed
Lock the narrative so later edits create a new version with a timestamp
Done when the narrative is locked with a reviewer sign-off and timestamp
verify: Confirm the lock records author, reviewer and timestamp
Confirm no returned point remains open on the account
Pass when the narrative is locked and sign-off recorded

generic.Defined scope/population: Every submission reaching an accept, decline or refer decision on the risk file

verify: Confirm the decision matches the status on the policy administration system record
Confirm the authority level exists in the current authority matrix

Write each factor with the evidence item on the file that supports it
Avoid restating the full analysis and keep the factors specific
Done when each decisive factor is written against its supporting evidence
verify: Confirm each factor cites an evidence item present on the file

steps.title: Cite the guideline or referral trigger applied
sop: Identify the guideline paragraph, appetite statement or referral trigger relied on
Record its name, version and paragraph reference in the note
Confirm the referenced version was in force at the decision date
Done when a versioned guideline reference is recorded on the note
verify: Confirm the cited version was effective on the decision date

steps.title: Record any deviation and its approver
sop: Compare the terms offered against the guideline standard terms
List each deviation from guideline in the note
Record the approver name, role and approval date for each deviation
Done when every deviation carries a named approver and date
verify: Confirm each approver held the authority to approve that deviation
Confirm no deviation is recorded without a date
Pass when all deviations carry a valid named approval

steps.title: Attach the rationale to the risk file and lock it for audit
sop: Attach the completed note to the risk file record in the workstation
Confirm the record is set so later edits generate an audit entry
Confirm the note is visible on the policy administration system case view
Done when the note is attached and audit-tracked on the risk file
verify: Confirm an edit attempt creates an audit entry rather than a silent change
Confirm the note is reachable from the policy record
Pass when the note is attached and audit tracking is active

sop: Read the rationale note against the authority matrix and the guideline cited
Confirm the decision sits inside the recorded authority level
Return the note where authority, guideline or deviation approval is missing

verify: Confirm the review outcome is recorded with reviewer and date

Record the variance percentage against benchmark for each year

Confirm a variance figure exists for each year

steps.title: Separate attritional from large losses in Microsoft Excel
sop: Apply the large-loss threshold to split the claim data into two layers
Compute frequency and severity separately for each layer
Comment on the behaviour of each layer over the experience period
Done when both layers carry their own metrics and commentary
verify: Confirm the threshold used is the current guideline threshold

Record each driver with the count and the years it appeared

verify: Confirm the grouped counts sum to the total claim count

sop: State whether the account runs better or worse than class on frequency and on severity
Record the variance percentage for each measure on the account
Confirm the benchmark source citation is present on the exhibit

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deviation list, classification, treaty position, pricing effect and disposition populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Clauses dispositioned equal the deviations identified in the redline
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Redline retained with base form edition and manuscript version identifiers recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every broadening deviation logged with its treaty position and pricing load
generic.Test population: All placements with manuscript wording reviewed in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a broadening deviation is accepted without a treaty or facultative position
generic.Exception handling path: Broadening outside treaty routes to facultative referral before acceptance
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every deviation classified and dispositioned in a clause-by-clause review
generic.Evidence location: Wording redline attached to the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Redline the manuscript wording against the base form
sop: Compare the requested manuscript wording against the approved base form
Mark every deviation in a redline document
Record the base form edition and the manuscript version identifiers
Done when the redline lists every deviation with both version identifiers
verify: Confirm the base form edition used is the current filed edition
Confirm every textual deviation appears in the redline
Pass when the redline is complete against the current base form

steps.title: Classify each deviation by effect
sop: Classify each deviation as coverage-broadening, clarifying or restrictive
Record the classification against the clause
State the coverage effect in one line for each
Done when every deviation carries a classification and stated effect
verify: Confirm no deviation is left unclassified
Confirm classifications match the clause text
Pass when all deviations are classified consistently with the text

steps.title: Test broadening deviations against the treaty
sop: For each broadening deviation, test coverage against the reinsurance treaty
Record whether the treaty covers the broadened grant
Raise a facultative referral where it does not
Done when every broadening deviation carries a treaty position
verify: Confirm the treaty version tested is the version in force
Confirm uncovered broadening shows an open referral
Pass when broadening is treaty covered or referred

steps.title: Price accepted broadening in the rating worksheet
sop: Determine the pricing load for each accepted broadening deviation
Apply the load in the rating worksheet
Confirm the load appears on the exported worksheet
Done when every accepted broadening carries a priced load
verify: Confirm the worksheet shows a load for each accepted broadening
Confirm the load basis is recorded
Pass when accepted broadening is priced and evidenced

steps.title: Record accept, amend or reject for each clause
sop: Record the disposition for each clause as accept, amend or reject
Where amending, state the wording change required
Return the marked-up wording to the broker
Done when every clause carries a disposition and the markup is returned
verify: Confirm the dispositioned clause count equals the deviation count
Confirm the returned markup matches the recorded dispositions
Pass when dispositions are complete and returned

steps.title: Approve the wording review before terms are finalised
sop: Read the redline, classifications, treaty positions and pricing loads
Challenge any acceptance without a treaty position or a priced load
Record approval or return the review with the point to rework
Done when the wording review carries a dated approval
verify: Confirm the approval is dated and attributed
Confirm no challenged clause remains open
Pass when the review is approved with no open challenge

generic.Defined scope/population: The base coverage form for each line being written on the placement
generic.In-scope period: The current filed form edition approved in the governing state at inception
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Form number, edition date, coverage trigger, state approval and rating compatibility populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Base forms selected equal the lines of business being written on the account
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Form schedule entry retained with form number and edition date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every proprietary form chosen over a bureau form logged with the supporting filing
generic.Test population: All quotes with a base form selected in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where the selected edition is not the current filed edition for the state
generic.Exception handling path: Superseded editions are replaced with the current edition before quote release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Base form recorded with form number and current filed edition for the governing state
generic.Evidence location: Form schedule on the quote in the policy administration system

steps.title: Select the base coverage form for the line
sop: Identify the line and the coverage trigger required as occurrence or claims-made
Select the base coverage form matching the line and trigger
Record the form number on the quote
Done when the base form matching line and trigger is selected
verify: Confirm the trigger of the selected form matches the requirement
Confirm one base form is selected per line written
Pass when form, line and trigger all align

steps.title: Confirm the edition is current and state approved
sop: Look up the current filed edition of the form for the governing state
Compare it against the edition selected on the quote
Replace the form where a newer edition is in force
Done when the selected edition is the current filed edition
verify: Confirm the edition date matches the current filing
Confirm state approval covers the governing state
Pass when the edition is current and state approved

steps.title: Confirm compatibility with the rating plan
sop: Compare the selected form against the rating plan and filing version in use
Confirm the form is supported by that rating basis
Resolve any incompatibility before proceeding
Done when form and rating basis are confirmed compatible
verify: Confirm the rating filing supports the selected form
Confirm no incompatibility warning remains open
Pass when form and rating basis are compatible

steps.title: Record the reason for a proprietary form choice
sop: Where a proprietary form is chosen over the bureau form, record the reason
Cite the filing that supports the proprietary form in the state
Attach the supporting filing reference to the quote
Done when the proprietary choice is reasoned and filing referenced
verify: Confirm the filing reference resolves for the governing state
Confirm the reason is specific to the placement
Pass when proprietary choices are reasoned and filed

steps.title: Record the form on the quote form schedule
sop: Record the selected form number and edition date on the form schedule
Confirm the schedule shows one base form per line written
Attach the schedule to the quote record
Done when the form schedule carries the base form for every line
verify: Confirm the schedule count equals the lines written
Confirm each entry shows number and edition date
Pass when the schedule is complete for all lines

steps.title: Confirm the base form selection before endorsements
sop: Read the form selection, edition currency and rating compatibility
Correct any element before jurisdiction endorsements are attached
Record confirmation that base form selection is complete
Done when the base form selection is confirmed and dated
verify: Confirm every element of the selection is recorded
Confirm the confirmation is dated and attributed
Pass when the selection is complete and confirmed

generic.Defined scope/population: Every governing jurisdiction on the placement and its mandatory endorsements and notices
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term under the state form requirements in force at inception
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Governing state per location, amendatory endorsements, notices and surplus lines status populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: States represented on the form schedule equal the states with insured locations
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Form schedule retained with endorsement numbers and edition dates recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every form compatibility conflict logged with the resolution applied
generic.Test population: All quotes with jurisdiction endorsements selected in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a state-mandatory endorsement or notice is missing for any location state
generic.Exception handling path: Missing mandatory endorsements block quote release until attached
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Every state-mandatory amendatory endorsement and notice present for each jurisdiction
generic.Evidence location: Form schedule on the quote in Guidewire PolicyCenter

steps.title: Determine the governing state for each location
sop: Read the exposure schedule and list the state of each insured location
Determine the governing state for the policy and any multi-state implications
Record the state list on the quote
Done when every location state and the governing state are recorded
verify: Confirm the state list matches the exposure schedule locations
Confirm the governing state is identified explicitly
Pass when states and governing state are complete and sourced

steps.title: Attach state-mandatory amendatory endorsements
sop: Look up the mandatory amendatory endorsements for each state on the list
Attach each to the quote in Guidewire PolicyCenter
Record the endorsement number and edition date for each
Done when every state has its mandatory endorsements attached
verify: Confirm each state on the list has its mandatory endorsements
Confirm each shows a number and edition date
Pass when mandatory endorsements are complete for every state

steps.title: Attach required notices for each state
sop: Attach cancellation and non-renewal notices required by each state
Attach terrorism disclosure and fraud warning notices where required
Record each notice on the form schedule
Done when every required notice is attached for each state
verify: Confirm each state shows its required notices
Confirm the notices are the current editions
Pass when notices are complete and current for every state

steps.title: Handle surplus lines placement requirements
sop: Determine whether the risk is placed on a surplus lines basis
Attach the surplus lines notice where it applies
Confirm diligent search evidence is on file for the placement
Done when surplus lines requirements are met or recorded as not applicable
verify: Confirm surplus lines placements carry the notice
Confirm diligent search evidence is attached where required
Pass when surplus lines requirements are satisfied or not applicable

steps.title: Run the form compatibility validation
sop: Run the form compatibility validation in the policy administration system
Read each conflict reported between base form and endorsements
Resolve each conflict and re-run the validation
Done when the validation runs clean with no open conflict
verify: Confirm the validation was re-run after the last change
Confirm zero conflicts are reported
Pass when the final validation run is clean

steps.title: Review the form schedule before quote release
sop: Read the schedule against the state list and mandatory requirements
Add any missing endorsement or notice before release
Record approval of the form schedule
Done when the form schedule carries a dated approval
verify: Confirm no state requirement is missing from the schedule
Confirm the approval is dated and attributed
Pass when the schedule is complete and approved

generic.Defined scope/population: Every deductible, retention and attachment point applying to the risk being quoted
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term tested against the five-year loss history
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Per-occurrence deductible, variants, aggregate, attachment points and credit factors populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Claims counted below each candidate deductible tie to the reviewed loss history
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Deductible analysis retained with the loss history valuation date recorded
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every gap or overlap with the underlying programme logged with the correction made
generic.Test population: All quotes with deductibles and attachment points set in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where a layer gap or overlap remains or the credit does not match the filed table
generic.Exception handling path: Gaps and overlaps return to structuring before the quote is released
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Values recorded with filed credit factors applied and no gaps between layers
generic.Evidence location: Deductible structure on the quote in the Earnix Rating and Pricing tool

steps.title: Count claims below each candidate deductible
sop: Take the five-year loss history and apply each candidate deductible level
Count the claims falling below each level
Quantify the loss burden shifted to the insured at each level
Done when counts and burdens are computed for every candidate level
verify: Confirm the claim counts tie to the reviewed loss history
Recompute one burden figure and compare it to the record
Pass when counts tie and recomputation matches

steps.title: Select the per-occurrence deductible and variants
sop: Select the per-occurrence deductible from the candidate levels
Record any per-claim or per-location variant that applies
State how each variant interacts with the per-occurrence level
Done when the deductible and every variant are recorded
verify: Confirm each variant is recorded with its basis
Confirm the interactions are stated explicitly
Pass when deductible and variants are complete and coherent

steps.title: Set the aggregate deductible and its erosion
sop: Set the aggregate deductible or stop-gap where the structure includes one
State how it erodes against paid or incurred amounts
Record the aggregate and its erosion basis on the quote
Done when the aggregate and its erosion basis are recorded
verify: Confirm the erosion basis is stated as paid or incurred
Confirm the aggregate is consistent with the per-occurrence level
Pass when the aggregate and erosion are recorded and coherent

steps.title: Set attachment points across the programme
sop: Set the attachment point for each excess layer on the placement
Compare each attachment against the underlying limit beneath it
Correct any gap or overlap between layers
Done when attachment points align with no gap or overlap
verify: Confirm each attachment equals the underlying limit exhaustion point
Confirm no gap or overlap remains
Pass when the layer chart is continuous with no overlap

steps.title: Apply filed deductible credit factors in Earnix
sop: Look up the filed deductible credit factors for the selected levels
Apply the credits in the pricing tool
Confirm the resulting premium credit matches the filed table
Done when the filed credit factors are applied and matched
verify: Confirm the applied credit equals the filed table value
Confirm the credit is applied in the filed sequence position
Pass when the credit matches the filed table and sequence

steps.title: Approve the deductible structure before quote release
sop: Read the deductible selection, aggregate, attachments and credits
Challenge any level unsupported by the loss analysis
Record approval or return the structure with the point to rework
Done when the structure carries a dated approval
verify: Confirm the approval is dated and attributed
Confirm no challenged element remains open
Pass when the structure is approved with no open challenge

generic.Defined scope/population: The final terms package tested against the appetite statement and the authority matrix
generic.In-scope period: The prospective policy term under the appetite and authority versions in force
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Class, geography, limit, attachment, premium, authority entry and result all populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Mandatory exclusions present equal the exclusions guideline and treaty require
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Validation result recorded with approver name, date and the limits tested against
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Every element outside appetite or authority logged with the approval obtained
generic.Test population: All accounts with a final terms validation in the review month
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Fail where any exception is released without a named approval
generic.Exception handling path: Out-of-appetite elements route to the required approval level before release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Validation record on the account with every exception carrying a named approval
generic.Evidence location: Appetite and authority validation record on the account in the underwriting workstation

steps.title: Check class and geography against the appetite statement
sop: Read the class, geography and industry of the account
Compare them against the documented appetite statement and the no-write list
Record the appetite result and the statement version used
Done when the appetite check result and its version are recorded
verify: Confirm the appetite version cited is the version in force
Confirm no-write matches are flagged rather than passed
Pass when the check is current and no-write items are flagged

steps.title: Test limit, attachment and premium against authority
sop: Read the deployed limit, attachment point and premium from the terms package
Compare each against the signing underwriter authority matrix entry
Record the authority entry tested and the result
Done when all three elements are tested against a cited authority entry
verify: Confirm the matrix entry cited matches the signing underwriter
Confirm each element shows a pass or an exception
Pass when all three elements are tested and recorded

steps.title: Confirm mandatory exclusions and treaty conditions are present
sop: Compare the final terms against the mandatory exclusion list
Compare against the treaty-required conditions for the placement
List any absent item and add it before release
Done when every mandatory exclusion and treaty condition is present
verify: Confirm the present set equals the required set
Confirm added items appear in the final terms package
Pass when no mandatory item is missing

steps.title: Raise exceptions for out-of-appetite elements
sop: List each element outside appetite or beyond authority
Raise an exception for each with the approval level required
Hold the terms from release while any exception is open
Done when every out-of-bounds element carries an open exception
verify: Confirm each out-of-bounds element has an exception
Confirm the terms are held while exceptions are open
Pass when exceptions are raised and the hold is in place

steps.title: Obtain and record the required approvals
sop: Review each exception against portfolio position and appetite
Approve or reject each with a recorded reason
Record the approver name and date against each exception
Done when every exception carries a named dated decision
verify: Confirm each exception shows an approver and a date
Confirm rejected exceptions show the terms change made
Pass when all exceptions carry named dated decisions

steps.title: Record the validation result on the account
sop: Record the overall validation result on the account
Record the approver name, the date and the specific limits tested against
Release the terms only when no exception remains open
Done when the validation result is recorded and the terms released
verify: Confirm the record names the limits tested and the approver
Confirm zero exceptions remain open at release
Pass when the validation is recorded and the release is clean
